prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / identity-preserve. Asset: the actual widescreen main-menu background of a Taiwanese psychological folk-horror game. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL full-resolution background and the EDIT TARGET, not just inspiration. Produce a high-detail 3840x1920 2:1 landscape image. Preserve the exact composition: near-black quiet LEFT 43% usable for live menu text; peeling red door pillar at about 43%; old carved gilded temple shrine and blindfolded seated Buddha in middle-right; same adult Taiwanese woman in the RIGHT foreground looking back over her shoulder, same face, hair, floral blouse, dark skirt, body pose, placement, scale, framing and perspective. NO UI, NO lettering, NO logos.
PRIMARY CORRECTION: completely reconstruct the woman's red blindfold as a continuous densely woven opaque deep oxblood cotton band, overlapping triple-thick folds covering BOTH eyes entirely from above eyebrows to upper cheekbones, with the same side knot and hanging tails. Absolutely no eye, iris, pupil, eyelash, eyelid, eye-shaped slit, hole, sheer weave, translucent area or eye contour can be visible. Her current band contains an eye-like exposed shape: eliminate it completely and replace it with solid fabric and irregular horizontal folds. Worn surface fibers are fine but no holes. The Buddha's red blindfold must also fully hide both eyes.
SECONDARY ART DIRECTION: make the scene significantly more sinister and unnervingly realistic, like a meticulous practical live-action Taiwanese horror film still at 02:47. Her expression is frozen, hollow and subtly threatening, lips barely parted, subtly pale cold skin without changing her identity or turning her into a monster. A narrow soft cold doorway light grazes her cheek, nose, mouth, jaw and neck so the skin detail remains clearly visible despite deep temple shadows. Resolve natural pores on nose and cheeks, fine facial peach fuzz, tiny skin creases, uneven pigmentation, a few minute sweat beads, realistic dry lip texture and strands of damp hair stuck against the skin. These must be actual anatomically credible photographic surface details, not oversharpening, noise or a uniform pore pattern. No beauty smoothing or waxy plastic skin. Preserve fine blouse weave and red cloth fibers. Deep desaturated green-black recesses, cold gray face highlights, restrained dirty amber candlelight, aged crimson cloth; richer layered shadows, blackened shrine, faint sparse incense haze BEHIND the subject, oppressive stillness, ominous shadowed Buddha. Increase eerie atmosphere without crushing the face into blackness. Keep facial texture as the sharpest focal detail; no foreground fog obscuring it. No added people, extra eyes, blood, injuries, creatures, floating particles, luminous eyes, fantasy effects, or jump-scare distortions. Maintain her existing identity, outfit, pose and all menu-safe space. Preserve the original's restrained photographic realism, with a noticeably more chilling mood and much clearer skin texture.
